mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.poem_id, s.track_kind, s.name, s.singer_id, s.cover, s.url, s.duration, s.style, s.play_count, s.create_time, si.name AS singer_name FROM song s LEFT JOIN singer si ON si.id = s.singer_id

where.if: AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

choose.when: ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY s.play_count DESC, s.id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.poem_id, s.track_kind, s.name, s.singer_id, s.cover, s.url, s.duration, s.style, s.play_count, s.create_time, si.name AS singer_name FROM song s LEFT JOIN singer si ON si.id = s.singer_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
ORDER BY s.play_count DESC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.poem_id, s.track_kind, s.name, s.singer_id, s.cover, s.url, s.duration, s.style, s.play_count, s.create_time, si.name AS singer_name FROM song s LEFT JOIN singer si ON si.id = s.singer_id WHERE s.id IN #{id} ORDER BY FIELD(s.id, #{id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO song (name, singer_id, poem_id, track_kind, cover, url, duration, style, play_count, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{singerId}, #{poemId}, #{trackKind}, #{cover}, #{url}, #{duration}, #{style}, #{playCount}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE song SET play_count = play_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
